_readme: Manual coordinates for COLLECTED US stores the Census geocoder cannot place (a redeveloped block, a TIGER address-range gap). Each is a last resort, applied only when Census returns no match, and the store is marked coord_src='manual' so the map draws it as a derived point, never as a chain-published one. Prefer a coordinate derived from Census matches of neighbouring addresses on the same street segment over any commercial source; state that derivation in the note. Keyed by the store's address; matching is on the normalised address.

overrides.address: 1199 S De Anza Blvd Suite 10, San Jose, CA 95129
overrides.note: Census has no TIGER range for the odd side of this S De Anza Blvd block, so 1199 is interpolated between the Census matches for 1180 (37.304869) and 1210 (37.302841) S De Anza Blvd on the same segment. 29 Sep 2026.

Census returns no match for this US-183 / Research Blvd frontage address (the whole frontage is a TIGER gap). Coordinate is the OpenStreetMap POI for the same store, 'Happy Lamb Hot Pot, 13343 Research Boulevard, Austin' (Research Blvd is the frontage name for US-183 here). 5 Oct 2026.

Census has no TIGER range for Grafton St in the Grafton Station development, Dublin (no match for any house number on the segment). Coordinate is the OpenStreetMap POI for the same store, 'Happy Lamb Hot Pot, Grafton Street, Grafton Station, Dublin'. 5 Oct 2026.

Census returns no match for this Beach Blvd (CA-39) block and OSM has no house-number or POI for 16310. Anchored to the nearest real OSM house-number match on the same corridor, 16400 Beach Blvd = Target (33.72598, -117.98575), nudged ~north toward 16310's lower house number. Approximate (~150 m), same Beach Blvd retail corridor; marked manual. 5 Oct 2026.
